•	Acts as a key enabler for EU AI Act Compliance
•	Strengthens NatWest’s enterprise AI Governance Model
•	Establishes a unified, enterprise-ready approach to managing the ML & GenAI lifecycle
•	Enhances transparency, monitoring, and operational readiness across AI system Team/Resources: Responsible AI Team.
resolved: Tell me about the AWS COMET implementation.

query: What cost savings did the Hubble migration achieve?
answer:
**Hubble migration to AWS** (Hubble) (Cost Savings: EUR24000/month): Rajesh has been working on Hubble migration project:
•	Hubble is an analytical store sourcing data from multiple sources i.e. (Kafka, Oracle, MongoDB etc.), processes it with StreamSet engines for further consumption
•	Hubble migration to AWS was initiated due to the approaching end-of-support for the Hadoop (HDFS) platform
•	Rajesh joined team with limited familiarity of the bank’s architecture and the Hubble platform and still successfully delivered the migration within the planned 6-month timeline
•	Coordinated with Kafka, Snowflake, Oracle, Firewall, and Infrastructure teams to ensure smooth implementation
•	Ensured all deployments aligned with the bank’s strict security, networking, and access control policies, which was a key challenge throughout the project
•	Addressed VPC IP exhaustion during deployment by adding a new CIDR range, creating new subnets, and moving selected resources without service impact
•	Recommended AWS S3 bucket replication instead of AWS Backup, achieving required resiliency while saving approximately £24,000 per month Team/Resources: Rajesh.
resolved: What cost savings did the Hubble migration achieve?
